page.content:
Empire that opened the Asia–Pacific war and attacked Pearl Harbor.

How Imperial Japan connects

  • Event: Pearl Harbor — Japan planned and executed the attack on Pearl Harbor.
  • Faction: Axis — Imperial Japan was the Pacific core of the Axis.
  • Event: Hiroshima — Hiroshima was the first atomic blow against Japan.
  • Character: Hideki Tojo — Tojo headed Japan when it attacked Pearl Harbor.

What is Imperial Japan?

Imperial Japan had already been at war in China when it struck the United States and European colonies in 1941. The Greater East Asia Co-Prosperity Sphere ended in surrender after Hiroshima and Nagasaki.

Key threads lead to Pearl Harbor, Axis, Hiroshima and Hideki Tojo.
